summary: Ads-Tec Energy Public Ltd Co, a Dublin-domiciled foreign private issuer listed on Nasdaq, furnished a Form 6-K covering the six months ended 30 June 2026. The filing contains quarterly financial statements, segment disclosures for North America and Europe, and XBRL-tagged balance-sheet detail on leases, loans and borrowings, trade payables, related-party balances and warrant liabilities tied to convertible notes and shareholder loans. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, activist campaign, going-private proposal, spin-off, capital return or management change is disclosed. This is a routine periodic reporting filing; no deal terms are stated.
